elaine: Quick heads-up — I'd like to postpone the unpin of runtime 2.16->2.17 for models in the `llama3q` group until we run a quick SDK compatibility sweep. SDK 1.9 introduced the adapter API change; saw a few failing integration tests on CI. Can we hold the unpin until tomorrow's change window? @deploy-bot please note.
deploy-bot: Request logged: `soft-unpin-request` for runtime 2.17 targeting group `llama3q`. Scheduled unpin currently: 2026-03-20T02:00Z. Action: HOLD at request of @elaine. To proceed manually run:

```
deploy-bot release unpin runtime --model-group llama3q --from 2.16 --to 2.17 --force
# or to cancel hold:
deploy-bot release unpin --cancel-hold --thread 1776543210
```
marco: Thanks, noted. Quick summary from canary runs this morning:
- canary latency unchanged
- kv-cache eviction tests: 3/120 failing for long-sequence quant workloads
- SDK 1.9 adapter change causes dtype mismatch in our test harness (small repro attached to CI run)
If we unpin now we risk a run of increased error rates for longseq quant models (~0.8% quality regressions observed) — not massive but above our rollback threshold (0.5%).
anya: tagging onto Marco — the failing cases are specifically `quant-v4b` + `kvcache-enabled` + `sdk>=1.9`. I can add a targeted canary job that runs the adapter path and the longseq suite, will take ~40m to complete. Recommend we gate the unpin on that job passing.
sam: For product/release notes: if we gate the change, please add a note in the release changelog: "Runtime 2.17: adapter API requires SDK >=1.9; canary validation needed for quantized long-sequence workloads." That helps CS and early adopters.
elaine: Plan: Hold unpin until Anya's canary completes. If canary passes, proceed in tomorrow change window with a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and monitor quality metrics for 60m at each stage. If canary fails, we keep runtime pinned and create a hotpatch branch to reconcile adapter shim in SDK or runtime.
marco: I'll prepare the staggered rollout plan and set the automatic rollback trigger: "if model-group error-rate delta > 0.5% or latency p99 increases by > 25ms within stage -> rollback to 2.16". I'll also add the canary job link to the ticket.
deploy-bot: Hold confirmed for thread 1776543210. Canary job requested by @anya: `ci/canary/llama3q-quant-longseq-adapter`. Estimated runtime 40m. Staged rollout template created: `rollout_template/staged-5-25-100.json`.
anya: Starting canary now. Will report back with the job link and results. ETA ~40m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: I'll update the release notes draft and flag CS to expect a potential delay. Thx.
elaine: Great. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick triage. Once canary finishes we reconvene here and either clear the hold or open a follow-up for a hotpatch
